end.parentNote: Asha practised counting sides and corners and naming shapes from these features. Ayaan explained that a triangle has three sides and three corners even when it is turned, and connected three lines to three corners. They needed some prompting when counting the star’s sides. At home, ask them to find shapes around the room and count their sides and corners, including shapes in different positions.
